title: Graham Breaks With Trump Over Russia Sanctions Law Her Brother Championed
summary: Senator Darline Graham, appointed to fill the Senate seat of her late brother, Lindsey, gently disagreed with the president’s decision to exempt Russia from the sanctions legislation.
